comparison.objective: Interpret a crewmate's pointing gesture and bring the indicated item to a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Gesture-based object selection and constrained pick-and-place.
comparison.success_condition: Indicated item upright on the white tray and all other items unchanged; tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Gesture grounding is the central tested ability and is unrelated to controlled industrial impact fracture.
